Washington 2018–19 Science 的县级人数加权比较：达标人数合计 ÷ 应考人数合计 × 100，再与相同完整学校记录构成的州样本基准比较。

主分析限定 `School`、`All` / `All Students`、`All Grades`、`Science`，保留 WCAS 和 AIM 两类测试；学校、学区、州记录不重复相加，`All Grades` 不再与单年级行相加。

## 结果摘要

39 个县全部匹配。完整公开学校记录的加权州基准为 47.47%；17 县高于、22 县低于该基准。2,904 条学校×测试记录中使用 1,566 条，排除 1,338 条，结果代表完整公开记录样本。

root <- here::here()

## 输入数据

使用成绩 CSV、Washington 县边界 GeoJSON 和官方字段字典。旧 `count_met_standard` 对应当前 `count_consistent_grade_level`；本题分母为 `count_of_students_expected`，不使用实考人数 `count_of_students_tested`。2026 更新后的现成百分比已回算为 tested 分母，不能直接代替题目要求。

```{r week02-hw-inputs}
assessment_file <- file.path(root, "data/raw/washington2018/assessment/report_card_assessment_2018_19_republished_20261014.csv")
county_file <- file.path(root, "data/raw/washington2018/boundaries/washington_counties_natural_shoreline.geojson")
dictionary_file <- file.path(root, "data/raw/washington2018/documentation/official_dataset_metadata.json")
metadata <- jsonlite::fromJSON(dictionary_file)
field_dictionary <- metadata$columns %>%
  dplyr::select(fieldName, name, description)
field_dictionary
```

### 完整读取

先按文字读取全表，保留代码前导零和抑制标记；人数随后显式转换。

```{r week02-hw-read-full}
report <- readr::read_csv(assessment_file, col_types = readr::cols(.default = readr::col_character()), na = c("", "NULL", "NA"))
required <- c("schoolyear", "organizationlevel", "county", "schoolorganizationid", "studentgrouptype", "studentgroup", "gradelevel", "testsubject", "testadministration", "test_administration_group", "count_of_students_expected", "count_of_students_tested", "count_consistent_grade_level", "dat", "dat_for_consistent_grade_level_knowledge_and_above_including_previously_passed_")
stopifnot(all(required %in% names(report)))
readr::problems(report)
dim(report)
dplyr::glimpse(report)
report %>% dplyr::count(schoolyear, organizationlevel)
```

## 记录层级与唯一键

主分析唯一键为“学校 × 测试”，不是单独学校代码。州记录留作独立核对，不进入学校人数求和。

```{r week02-hw-filter}
report %>% dplyr::filter(testsubject == "Science") %>% dplyr::count(studentgrouptype, studentgroup, sort = TRUE)
science <- report %>%
  dplyr::filter(schoolyear == "2018-19", testsubject == "Science", studentgrouptype == "All", studentgroup == "All Students", gradelevel == "All Grades")
science %>% dplyr::count(organizationlevel, testadministration, test_administration_group)
schools <- science %>%
  dplyr::filter(organizationlevel == "School", !is.na(county), county != "Multiple", testadministration %in% c("WCAS", "AIM"))
stopifnot(nrow(schools) > 0L, all(schools$testadministration == schools$test_administration_group))
school_keys <- schools %>% dplyr::count(schoolorganizationid, testadministration)
stopifnot(!anyNA(schools$schoolorganizationid), all(school_keys$n == 1L))
schools %>% dplyr::count(testadministration, dat, sort = TRUE)
```

## DAT 与完整人数对

只使用 general DAT 为 `None` 且分子、分母完整的记录。保密值（如 `<10`）保留为缺失，不填零。

```{r week02-hw-counts}
strict_count <- function(x) {
  out <- rep(NA_real_, length(x))
  ok <- !is.na(x) & grepl("^[0-9]+$", x) # 保密符号不转成人数
  out[ok] <- as.numeric(x[ok])
  out
}
schools <- schools %>%
  dplyr::mutate(expected = strict_count(count_of_students_expected), met = strict_count(count_consistent_grade_level), county_key = stringr::str_to_upper(stringr::str_squish(county)))
schools %>% dplyr::count(dat, dat_for_consistent_grade_level_knowledge_and_above_including_previously_passed_, sort = TRUE)
schools <- schools %>%
  dplyr::mutate(usable = !is.na(dat) & dat == "None" & !is.na(expected) & !is.na(met) & expected > 0 & met >= 0 & met <= expected)
schools %>% dplyr::count(testadministration, usable)
```

## 县级加权汇总

按县汇总完整记录的达标人数和应考人数，再计算百分比。保密记录被排除，结果仅代表完整公开记录样本。

```{r week02-hw-county-totals}
coverage <- schools %>%
  dplyr::group_by(county_key) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(n_records = dplyr::n(), n_used = sum(usable), n_excluded = sum(!usable), known_expected_all = sum(expected, na.rm = TRUE), known_expected_used = sum(expected[usable]), .groups = "drop")
county_only <- schools %>%
  dplyr::filter(usable) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(county_key) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(total_county_met_standard = sum(met), total_county_to_test = sum(expected), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(percent_met_per_county = 100 * total_county_met_standard / total_county_to_test)
county_only <- coverage %>% dplyr::left_join(county_only, by = "county_key", relationship = "one-to-one")
stopifnot(!anyNA(county_only$county_key), !anyDuplicated(county_only$county_key))
county_only %>% dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(n_excluded))
```

## 样本州基准与县差值

基准来自相同完整学校记录的全州人数合计，不对学校率或县率作简单平均。县率减州基准的差值以百分点计，分类前保留原精度；`1e-8` 仅作浮点容差。

```{r week02-hw-state-comparison}
stopifnot(sum(county_only$total_county_to_test, na.rm = TRUE) > 0)
state_average <- 100 * sum(county_only$total_county_met_standard, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(county_only$total_county_to_test, na.rm = TRUE)
county_comparison <- county_only %>%
  dplyr::mutate(difference_to_state = percent_met_per_county - state_average, above_below = dplyr::case_when(is.na(difference_to_state) ~ "无完整公开人数对", difference_to_state > 1e-8 ~ "高于样本州基准", difference_to_state < -1e-8 ~ "低于样本州基准", TRUE ~ "与样本州基准相同"))
state_average
county_comparison %>% dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(difference_to_state))
```

### 官方 State 行核对

官方州汇总可能保有学校公开行中的隐藏人数，属于独立口径，不替换主图基准，也不用于反推学校隐私计数。

```{r week02-hw-official-state-check}
official_state <- science %>%
  dplyr::filter(organizationlevel == "State", testadministration %in% c("WCAS", "AIM")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(expected = strict_count(count_of_students_expected), met = strict_count(count_consistent_grade_level))
stopifnot(nrow(official_state) == 2L, all(official_state$dat == "None"), !anyDuplicated(official_state$testadministration), all(is.finite(official_state$expected)), all(is.finite(official_state$met)), all(official_state$expected > 0), all(official_state$met <= official_state$expected))
official_state_rate <- 100 * sum(official_state$met) / sum(official_state$expected)
tibble(basis = c("完整公开学校记录样本", "官方 State All Grades 行"), percent = c(state_average, official_state_rate))
```

## 县边界与连接

当前字段为 `COUNTYLABEL`，旧 Shapefile 的 `countylabe` 是截短名称。县名统一后双向检查漏接，再作一对一左连接；缺数据的县保留边界。

```{r week02-hw-read-boundary}
shape <- sf::st_read(county_file, quiet = TRUE)
stopifnot("COUNTYLABEL" %in% names(shape))
stopifnot(nrow(shape) == 39L, !any(sf::st_is_empty(shape)))
shape <- shape %>% dplyr::mutate(county_key = stringr::str_to_upper(stringr::str_squish(COUNTYLABEL)))
stopifnot(!anyNA(shape$county_key), !anyDuplicated(shape$county_key))
sf::st_crs(shape)
unmatched_counts <- dplyr::anti_join(county_comparison, sf::st_drop_geometry(shape), by = "county_key")
unmatched_shape <- dplyr::anti_join(sf::st_drop_geometry(shape), county_comparison, by = "county_key")
unmatched_counts
unmatched_shape
stopifnot(nrow(unmatched_counts) == 0L)
```

```{r week02-hw-join}
joined_data <- shape %>% dplyr::left_join(county_comparison, by = "county_key", relationship = "one-to-one")
stopifnot(nrow(joined_data) == nrow(shape))
joined_data <- joined_data %>% dplyr::mutate(above_below = tidyr::replace_na(above_below, "无完整公开人数对"))
sf::st_drop_geometry(joined_data) %>% dplyr::select(COUNTYLABEL, percent_met_per_county, difference_to_state, n_used, n_excluded, above_below)
```

## 高于／低于基准地图

蓝色表示低于州样本基准，红色表示高于，灰色表示缺失。

```{r week02-hw-map}
tmap::tmap_mode("plot")
map_font <- "Arial Unicode MS"
map_colors <- c("低于样本州基准" = "#2166ac", "高于样本州基准" = "#b2182b", "与样本州基准相同" = "#f7f7f7", "无完整公开人数对" = "#bdbdbd")
wa_map <- tmap::tm_shape(joined_data) +
  tmap::tm_polygons(fill = "above_below", fill.scale = tmap::tm_scale_categorical(values = map_colors), fill.legend = tmap::tm_legend(title = "县与样本州基准比较", title.fontfamily = map_font, text.fontfamily = map_font)) +
  tmap::tm_title("Washington Science, 2018–19：完整公开记录样本", fontfamily = map_font) +
  tmap::tm_layout(text.fontfamily = map_font)
wa_map
```

## 可选导出

结果保存为 CSV、PNG 和 GeoPackage。

```{r week02-hw-export, eval=FALSE}
output_dir <- file.path(root, "week02/outputs")
dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
csv_out <- file.path(output_dir, "washington-science-2018-19-my-run.csv")
png_out <- file.path(output_dir, "washington-science-2018-19-my-run.png")
gpkg_out <- file.path(output_dir, "washington-science-2018-19-my-run.gpkg")
stopifnot(!any(file.exists(c(csv_out, png_out, gpkg_out))))
readr::write_csv(sf::st_drop_geometry(joined_data), csv_out)
tmap::tmap_save(wa_map, filename = png_out, device = ragg::agg_png, width = 9, height = 7, units = "in", dpi = 180)
sf::st_write(joined_data, gpkg_out, layer = "county_science", quiet = TRUE)
data.frame(file = c(csv_out, png_out, gpkg_out), exists = file.exists(c(csv_out, png_out, gpkg_out)))
```
